label: Casino Meme
description: Duckling mit Dice, Coins, Casino-Requisiten und klarer Meme-Pointe.
prompt: Use the DuckDice casino-meme composition: one clear duckling, dice or casino prop, bright readable comic staging, and one strong visual punchline. Keep the background supportive, not busy.

label: Cinematic Comic
description: Detaillierte illustrierte Szene mit Licht, Tiefe und kleiner Geschichte.
prompt: Use the Quackicists cinematic comic style from the production references: simple yellow cartoon ducklings with clean dark outlines and soft cel shading, warm amber interiors against cold rainy blue exteriors, moody illustrated backgrounds, expressive eyes, emotional restraint, slow-cinema composition, and a readable narrative moment. No photorealism, gritty noir, heavy texture, or text in the image.

label: Reaction Close-up
description: Großes ausdrucksstarkes Gesicht, klare Reaktion und kurze Sprechblase.
prompt: Use the DuckDice reaction-meme style: medium close-up or close-up, oversized expressive eyes and beak, a very clear emotional reaction, and one short speech bubble or banner.

label: Action & Chaos
description: Dynamische Pose, Impact-Lines, dramatische Requisiten und übertriebene Comic-Energie.
prompt: Use the DuckDice action-comic style: dynamic pose, strong diagonal composition, expressive gesture, comic impact lines or controlled motion cues, and a funny exaggerated situation.

label: Ensemble World
description: Mehrere Ducklings oder eine größere DuckDice-Welt mit Szene und Nebenfiguren.
prompt: Use the DuckDice ensemble-world style: a coherent illustrated environment such as a casino, neon room, office, or cave, with a clear main duckling and up to three supporting ducklings or characters.
